# NeighborChange Interface

> [!CAUTION]
> This interface is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information regarding a block change in one neighboring direction.

## Properties

### **blockPermutation**
`blockPermutation: BlockPermutation;`

The permutation of the neighboring block after its last change during the tick.

Type: [*BlockPermutation*](BlockPermutation.md)

### **direction**
`direction: Direction;`

Direction from the block receiving the event to the neighboring block that changed.

Type: [*Direction*](Direction.md)

### **previousPermutation**
`previousPermutation: BlockPermutation;`

The permutation of the neighboring block before its first change during the tick.

Type: [*BlockPermutation*](BlockPermutation.md)
